script.text: It is raining heavily in Colombo.
Kasun stands beside his small three-wheeler, selling homemade short eats and tea to office workers.
His clothes are simple, but his eyes are full of ambition.
Across the road, Anudi steps out of a comfortable family car, dressed elegantly and holding an umbrella.
She accidentally drops her phone near Kasun's three-wheeler.
Kasun picks it up and runs after her.
She looks at his little business.
Suddenly, her phone rings. It is her father.
She looks at Kasun one more time.

lines.speaker: Kasun
lines.text: One day… I'll have my own restaurant.

lines.speaker: Kasun
lines.text: Started with Rs. 5,000. I'm trying to make it bigger.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Anudi, where are you? Come home. We need to talk about your marriage.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He had no idea that this meeting was about to change his life.

treatment.logline: In monsoon rain, a humble street vendor returns a fallen phone to a young woman from comfort; a spark forms, but a parent’s call breaks it, leaving him watching the rain as fate whispers change.

arc.beat: Rain, work, and a private vow
arc.feeling: Grounded, intimate; ambition flickers beneath hardship.
A sudden possibility touches the frame.
Tentative curiosity turns to genuine regard.
Cold reality cuts through warmth; a promise stalls.
Yearning and a quiet promise of more.

treatment.approach: Naturalistic handheld and restrained dolly, rain-forward soundscape, faces favoured over coverage. One vision: cool Colombo greys and blues, with warm skin tones and steam from tea as the emotional counterpoint. Keep moves minimal—one purposeful motion per shot. Perform the spoken lines in clean singles; let reactions breathe in the same frames rather than multiplying angles.

treatment.geography: Kasun’s three-wheeler is curbside under a makeshift awning; counter and tea flask face the pavement. A family car pulls up across the wet two-lane road. Pedestrian flow runs along the stall side; puddles collect by the gutter. Sightlines: from stall to car across the road; approach path brings Anudi past the stall edge where the phone falls.
treatment.key_image: Kasun, damp under the awning, eyes following her into sheets of rain while steam coils from his tea flask.
advice: Protect lenses and mics from rain; keep rain continuity (intensity, droplet size) between shots.
Never show the caller; keep phone VO strictly off-screen. A listener is written as ‘listens’.
Keep the stall props fixed for geography continuity (menu, cash box, tea flask positions).
One move per shot. If in doubt, lock off and let the rain carry motion.
Give 1 s handles around action; 0.8 s for tight 4 s takes; long call on 8 s.
Thought and VO are never performed—lips closed. Keep faces framed so the audience reads the change.

moments.what: Heavy rain over Colombo; Kasun tends his tiny stall by the three-wheeler.
moments.feeling: Immersed in rain, sensing grit and quiet ambition.
moments.cut_uses: master, WIDE at stall—locked-off to let rain paint the frame and place us.

moments.what: Kasun’s private vow drifts over his face.
moments.feeling: Intimacy with his drive; a soft push-in to carry the thought.
moments.cut_uses: single, MCU on Kasun—gentle dolly-in to cradle the thought.

moments.what: Across the road, Anudi arrives with an umbrella; the phone slips near the stall.
moments.feeling: A bright note in grey; chance enters.
moments.cut_uses: master, MWS spanning car to stall—slow pan reveal to catch the drop.

moments.what: Kasun grabs the phone and moves after her, calling out.
moments.cut_uses: single, MS on Kasun—short tracking move for urgency; performs L7.

moments.what: She turns; first words of thanks.
moments.cut_uses: single, MS on Anudi—still frame to let the words land; performs L9.

moments.what: She takes in his stall and asks about it.
moments.cut_uses: single, MCU on Anudi with a soft rack—from stall to her eyes; performs L11.

moments.what: He smiles, then shares his small origin and big aim.
moments.cut_uses: single, MS on Kasun—held frame; performs L13 (smile sits before it).

moments.what: Her returning smile is cut by a ring; she listens as the call chills the air.
moments.feeling: A warm thread tugged cold; responsibility closes in.
moments.cut_uses: single, MCU on Anudi—held, let the ring and phone voice play across her face.

moments.what: She gives him one last look and a parting line.
moments.feeling: Tender uncertainty, a promise in the rain.
moments.cut_uses: single, MS on Anudi—still, eyes flick before she speaks; performs L19.

moments.what: She walks away into the rain.
moments.feeling: Distance grows; we hold the emptying frame.
moments.cut_uses: clean_exit, MWS—locked-off, she leaves the held frame.

moments.what: Kasun watches her go; fate’s VO closes the scene.
moments.feeling: Yearning suspended; possibility blooms under rain.
moments.cut_uses: master, WIDE—slow dolly-out to end on small Kasun in big rain while VO plays.

editor_notes: The intended cut is lean: masters for geography, singles for lines, one held call shot. Editors can punch-in digitally on singles; we’ve left clean heads and tails.
If the drop needs emphasis, an insert of the phone splash can intercut Moment 3 without changing geography.
Keep caller unseen; all references are ‘the call’ only. The closing VO rides over the final master; do not cut away mid-VO unless punching-in.

editor_notes: The intended cut is lean: masters for geography, singles for lines, one held call shot. Editors can punch-in digitally on singles; we’ve left clean heads and tails.
If the drop needs emphasis, an insert of the phone splash can intercut Moment 3 without changing geography.
Keep caller unseen; all references are ‘the call’ only. The closing VO rides over the final master; do not cut away mid-VO unless punching-in.
blend_notes: c15 — Moment 8: cut in on the first ring (b15) between c13 and c08; over rain and phone ring SFX (no dialogue).
c16 — Moment 8: lay over the middle of the call while c08 holds her; under L16 (phone voice) audio.
c17 — Moment 3: cut in at the drop (b5) for the splash, then return to c03; over ambient rain.
c18 — Moment 4: cut in on the grab (b6) just before L7, then back to c04 for the line; over ambient rain/foot splash.
c19 — Moment 2: layer under Kasun’s thought while c02 carries the face; under L3 audio.
c20 — Moment 1: open the scene with top-down rain on the curb, then into c01; over ambient rain.
c21 — Moment 10: close after she clears frame in c11 with a short pull-back; over ambient rain.
c22 — Moment 11: layer under the opening bars of the closing VO, then back to c12’s dolly-out; under L22 audio.

review.why: The phone ring interrupts their warmth: an ECU of the phone (c15) punctuates the break, and rain texture on the umbrella (c16) carries the pressure of the call under the anchor without leaving her face.
The close needs room for the VO: dripping awning detail (c22) lets the line bloom without competing with the final master.
The mishap that triggers the scene benefits from a crisp insert: a slow-motion splash on the dropped phone (c17) makes the accident readable and cinematic.
Momentum into first contact: a tactile insert of the grab (c18) ties Kasun’s impulse to act to rain and texture.
His inner vow asks for a visual counterpoint: tea steam (c19) adds warmth under the thought without leaving his single.
To set weather and place before we meet him: a top-down puddle texture (c20) opens the scene and grounds the rain soundscape.
After she exits, a brief empty-frame pull-back (c21) gives the editor a breath before the final image.
Her thanks lands clean in the must single; adding a cutaway would dilute the first eye contact and slow pacing.
The must rack onto her eyes already provides the cinematic beat; more coverage would repeat the idea.
His pride and line sit well in a held single; a second angle would be redundant and risk over-cutting the honesty.
Her parting line is designed to play straight; a cutaway would undercut the fragile, direct promise.
